pages.text: Runs on lava without using it up. $(b)15 FE/t$() for every lava source below it or on its four sides, up to 75 FE/t. Half again more in the Nether.
Only lava sources count, flowing lava does not. The fan on top turns and the front window glows while it works. Buffer 50,000 FE.
